task.title: Orbit view: curve cache cap of 64 makes render cost jump past ~26 vessels
task.body:
Orbit-view render cost jumps between 26 and 50 vessels in one system because the orbit-line geometry cache is capped at 64 curves (`curveCacheCap`, `internal/tui/widgets/canvas_curve_cache.go:61`).

**Measured (2026-10-22, #710 perf pass, 140x40 tmux):**
- `OrbitView.Render`: 2.3-2.6 ms flat up to 26 vessels, 5.5 ms at 50.
- Orbit view CPU at 1x warp: 1.05x the 1-vessel cost at 26 vessels, 1.60x at 50.
- With the cap raised to 256 in a scratch build, the 50-vessel render went back to 2.7 ms.

**To do:** find the vessel count where the cache starts missing (curves per vessel), size the cap for the #710 batch (about 24-29 satellites plus carrier and debris, with margin), and check memory per entry before raising it (the v0.36 cache review found 28-81 MB unbounded growth in an earlier cache). Keep the cached-vs-truth test honest (prove it red with a key sabotage).

Context: #710 (Starlink-style batch launch).
